says: In today's version, L7's check that a process on the Electron binary carries the switch fires only for a command line that starts with the exact path the test holds, so a child whose binary path is spelled another way passes unchecked, and a green run prints no group listing to tell.
proof: helpers.host.test.ts:119 tests `p.line.startsWith(`${electron} `)` before it looks for ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1. The by-hand run at head 0af17320c passed 6 of 6, and its saved output holds only vitest's summary: no pid or command line of any group member.
cost: If codex-acp's child names the binary through a link, L7 stays green with the switch missing on that child. The Electron Helper and LaunchServices checks in the same law would still catch an app that booted.
